evidence_limits: UF146378 supplies exterior plan and interior shelf but no lateral height view; height is an explicit taxon-level inference using a separate conspecific comparison
No exact soft-body, shell colour in life, hidden internal coil or damage reconstruction is supported
Broad fossil context is Pliocene, not a co-occurrence scene with other assets

reference_specimens.comparison: Trochita floridana PRI70705: Pliocene Tamiami Formation (Pinecrest Beds), Sarasota County, Florida; reported height about2.5cm. Institutional scan thumbnail viewed solely for comparative lateral shell profile.
reference_specimens.primary: Trochita floridana UF146378: photographed exterior/top and underside, scale 5cm; Late Pliocene Tamiami Formation (Pinecrest Beds), Okeechobee County, Florida.
reference_specimens.scope: Original low-poly genus-level fossil study informed by two explicitly separate conspecific specimens; not an exact scan or UF height measurement, and not modern Trochita trochiformis.

scale.diameter_basis: UF146378 image: approximately304px shell diameter against318px white 5cm scale strip =>47.8mm; image estimate, not caliper measurement.
scale.height_basis: Explicitly inferred illustrative height, constrained by cap shape and comparative PRI70705 lateral view; NOT a measured height of UF146378. PRI70705 stated25mm is not transferred as UF measurement.
scale.scope: Genus-level specimen-informed study; do not advertise exact specimen dimensions or a morphometric replica.

frozen_scientific_scope.target: Original genus fossil-form target retained: broad cap shell with offset spiral summit and internal shelf. Add the directly observed strong radial ribs, not a featureless conical limpet.
